test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

AMIABLE
solution: The correct answer is '**Friendly**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Amiable**' is '**Friendly**'. • **Amiable**: friendly and pleasant. (मैत्रीपूर्ण और सौहार्दपूर्ण; मिलनसार) • *Example: There had been something remarkably **amiable** about her.* • **Friendly**: behaving in a kind and open way. [(व्‍यवहार) जिसमें आत्‍मीयता और खुलापन हो; मैत्रीपूर्ण, दोस्‍ताना] • *Example: Everyone here has been very **friendly** towards us.* **Correct Answer:__** *Friendly.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Bitter**: caused by anger or hatred. (क्रोध या घृणा से प्रेरित, कड़वाहट-भरा) • **Rude**: not polite. [अशिष्‍ट (किसी के प्रति) (किसी बात पर)] • **Aloof**: not friendly to other people; distant. (मेल-जोल न बढ़ाने वाला; अलग, दूर, भावशून्‍य) 3c:Ta72, The correct answer is '**Honeycomb**'.
